notes.title: Update version 1.1.1 (patch notes) : Antivirus Issue, please read
notes.notes:
Updated / downdated the game back to the most reliable earlier build known, downgrading from Unity 2018 to Unity 2017. Includes :

-Fixed the Out Of Array error that slipped by and caused the random issues to happen to certain players, but not all. 
-Rebaking of lighting in Orphanage environment, which will now look different from the Unity 2018 version.

Downgrading to Unity 2017 might make your antivirus software trigger and isolate specific files. Please be sure to create an exception to the files necessary for the game to launch. For more information on this issue, please read the official Steam Support page about antiviruses.

Released on April 5th 2021, Somewhat Software's first game I Make Saints is 15% off on its already low price of 2.99US$ to celebrate its launch!

Play it now!

notes.title: I Make Saints release date announced
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40083256/5f5a5c48aca79f69878c9adea766e9babe5e72e5.png
Prepare to experience the dark cult classic underground indie game I Make Saints on Steam, on April 5th 2021. 

Somewhat Software finally brings their very first game, originally released in 2017, to Steam in an exclusive new Director's Cut edition. 

Get ready to dive into the mind of a disturbing individual again, as you go deeper into their psyche in an entirely new environment previously unavailable anywhere else, hear a new track unused in the original release and get an overall better gaming experience with small tweaks here and there.

For newcomers, ready yourselves for a short but disconcerting walking simulator about the unspeakable crimes of a mind longing for a redemption they will never find.

Welcome to guilt.
